rows.headline: Understanding life insurance grace periods and revival processes
rows.hook: Grace periods prevent immediate policy termination
rows.summary: Life insurance policies do not lapse immediately upon a missed premium payment due to a mandatory grace period. Once this period expires, the policy enters a lapsed state, resulting in the loss of coverage and benefits. Policyholders can revive their coverage by paying outstanding premiums along with applicable interest and penalties. The specific revival terms and timelines are determined by the insurer's internal policies and the duration of the lapse.
rows.why_it_matters: Avoid losing your life cover by tracking premium due dates.
